title: EcoCAT: Ecosystem Conservation Assessment Tools
text: This project aims to develop an open, modular application to assess ecosystem distribution, trends, function, degradation and risk of collapse following the IUCN Red List of Ecosystems guidelines

title: EcoCAT: Ecosystem Conservation Assessment Tools
text:
Tools






Mapping tool: automated ecosystem mapping and how they change over time.



 


Assessment tool: assess ecosystem status following Red List of Ecosystems Guidelines.
